title: UI风格#23 - Steampunk Mechanical (蒸汽朋克)
description: 创建第23种UI风格：蒸汽朋克风格 - 铜色金属、齿轮装饰、维多利亚工业。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planW.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk style When color palette Then features copper, brass, bronze metals with dark brown and steam
Given Steampunk style When typography Then uses Victorian fonts: Cinzel, Uncial Antiqua, or Playfair Display
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Cinzel (标题), Uncial Antiqua (装饰), Lora (正文)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk style When layout Then gear patterns, pipe networks, pressure gauges, riveted panels
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：齿轮图案、管道网络、压力表、铆钉面板、蒸汽效果

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk style When UI elements Then brass borders, gear rotations, steam animations, gauge meters
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：黄铜边框、齿轮旋转、蒸汽动画、仪表指示

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk UI When functional Then includes steampunk chat, brass agents, gauge stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：蒸汽朋克聊天、黄铜代理、仪表统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk UI When copy Then uses Victorian-industrial: 'Engine', 'Pressure', 'Steam', 'Mechanism'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'ENGINE. PRESSURE. STEAM.'、按钮'SEND'→'IGNITE'、'SUBMIT'→'ENGAGE'
